name: wisecraft
description: Game trailers, balance, meta and QA with an AI agent: a trailer cut from the real game (frame-exact slow motion, beat-cut EDL, titles, music mixed to loudness, vertical and 16:9), balance and economy tuned with player-model bots, meta and monetization design (loot boxes with pity, currencies, shop, season pass, fair odds), and virtual QA testers that play like players in a muted phone browser. Plus UI, game feel, design boards and agent orchestration extras.
